medium.en: Woodblock print; ink and colour on paper

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1849. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1849 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A full moon hangs over the Yodo River at Osaka. Riverboats crowded with passengers glide on the blue water past the stone walls and white keep of a castle on the right, with low green banks and hills beyond.
alt.zh: 满月悬在大阪的淀川上空。载满乘客的船在蓝色河面上滑行，经过右侧的石垣和白色城楼；远处是低矮的绿岸和山丘。

note.en: Hokusai’s series Snow, Moon and Flowers sets each of the three classical pleasures at a famous place; the moon is given to the Yodo, with Osaka Castle at the water’s edge. The night is not dark at all but a clear blue evening, and the moon is a pale disc. It is a picture of people out on the water together, enjoying the light.
note.zh: 北斋的《雪月花》把三种古典的赏玩各放在一处名胜：月给了淀川，大阪城就在水边。这一夜一点也不黑，是一个清亮的蓝色傍晚，月亮只是一枚淡淡的圆。画的是人们一起到水上去，享受这份光。
